column20: PM 10 - particle matter with size of 10 micrometers or smaller
PM 2.5 - particle matter with size of 2.5 micrometers or smaller
Before 2018, they don't record the data for PM2.5
1. They don't have the ability to measure the particle matter smaller than or equal to that size, so just include in PM10
observe : from the PM10 before 2018, the concentration is significantly higher
2. The air condition becomes worse from 2018, the particle matter with smaller size spread into the air
